description: Land Acquisition - Ellewatta, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Kataragama, Kataragama D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels and servitudes for public purposes, including descriptions of land lots, claimants, extents, and compensation procedures. The content falls squarely within the "Land and property-related matters" category, specifically covering land acquisitions as defined for Type 4 classification.
